title: Tier Changes and Account Record Updates, Resident Trust Fund Accounts
content:
**Rule.** The Resident Trust Fund Accounts tier changes when the records change: Medicaid eligibility moves the account to the matching Medicaid tier from the eligibility start date, the end of eligibility moves it back, an SSA payee appointment or a guardianship order moves it to the payee or guardianship tier from the date of appointment or order, and a revoked payee appointment or discharged guardianship moves it back to self-directed. The tier effective date records when the change applies. A standing authorization is recorded only from the written authorization the resident or legal representative signed, and the guardian's name is recorded exactly as in the court order.

## Change table

| Event in the records | Account moves to | Effective from |
|---|---|---|
| Medical Assistance eligibility begins | the matching Medicaid tier | the eligibility start date |
| Medical Assistance eligibility ends | back to the matching Non-Medicaid tier | the end of eligibility |
| SSA appoints the center representative payee | the payee tier | the date of appointment |
| a court appoints a guardian of the estate | the guardianship tier | the date of the order |
| the payee appointment is revoked | back to the self-directed tier | the revocation |
| the guardianship is discharged | back to the self-directed tier | the discharge of the guardianship |

## What each tier family carries with it

The payee tiers carry the annual representative payee accounting filed with SSA; the guardianship tiers carry the annual accounting prepared for the guardian's report to the Orphans' Court; the self-directed tiers carry neither.

## Hypothetical illustration

A Non-Medicaid Self-Directed account's resident is approved for Medical Assistance with eligibility from 1 May. The account moves to the Medicaid Self-Directed tier with a tier effective date of 1 May, even if the approval notice arrives later.
